evals.prompt: Review this change. A new Export dialog starts a report download that takes several seconds. The Export button calls the API and does nothing visible until the file arrives; there is no spinner, no disabled state and no success message. It is built from DS components.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.expected_output: U1 FAILs: the long action gives no status. Fix: a pending state on the button and a success or failure message. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
